job: In the CNC cell, wipe the coolant off the fixture table, then take the finished aluminium housing off the table and carry it out to the inspection cart by the roller door. The housing weighs about three and a half kilos.
understood_as: In the CNC cell, wipe the coolant off the fixture table, then lift the finished aluminium housing (about 3.5 kg) off the table and carry it out to the inspection cart by the roller door.
steps: Wipe the coolant off the fixture table with a cloth.
Pick up the finished aluminium housing from the table.
Carry the housing out of the cell by the way out.

demos.why: Shows the stroke pattern and pressure for wiping coolant off the fixture table.
Shows how firmly to hold the cloth so it does not slip out while pressing on a wet, oily surface.
Shows how the hand approaches, grasps and lifts the housing clear of the fixture.
Shows how hard to grip a 3.5 kg housing with coolant on it so it does not slip, without marking the finished part.

questions: The inspection cart by the roller door has not been located in the scan, so the robot can only carry the housing to the way out. Is leaving it at the way out acceptable, or can you mark the inspection cart's position so it can be added later?
unmet: Setting the housing down on the inspection cart by the roller door: the planner can only route to the way out, so the housing will be carried out but not placed on the cart.
